lines.zh: 上回《LiL：暑假》……

lines.en: : Let’s go, Tyler! You’re coming with me!
lines.zh: : 走了，Tyler！你跟我来！

lines.en: : But I’m not done with my juice box yet!
lines.zh: : 可我果汁盒还没喝完呢！

lines.en: : If the viewers want Noriko, we just need to give them Noriko. But what I struggle with now is understanding how {i}to{/i} give them Noriko.
lines.zh: : 如果观众想要 Noriko，我们就给他们 Noriko。可我现在纠结的是，到底该{i}怎么{/i}把 Noriko 给他们。

lines.en: : We’ve exhausted practically every single type of sex scene in the book with Lessons in Love. So what can we give viewers {i}now{/i} that they haven’t already seen?
lines.zh: : 《Lessons in Love》几乎已经把书上每一种性爱场面都用尽了。那我们{i}现在{/i}还能给观众什么他们没看过的东西？

lines.en: : I guess there’s always a dog too.
lines.zh: : 我想还可以加只狗。

lines.en: : I still don’t get why we need to film a full-on porno in the first place. Like, wasn’t there a whole plan about purity routes or something once Lessons in Love ended?
lines.zh: : 我还是不明白我们为什么要拍一部彻头彻尾的色情片。比如说，《Lessons in Love》结束后不是有一整套「纯洁路线」之类的计划吗？

lines.en: : There was at first until funding dried out. I think it just got to a point where it was no longer sustainable, which is ultimately what led us here.
lines.zh: : 起初是有，直到资金枯竭。我想事情到了无法维持的地步，最终就把我们带到了这里。

lines.en: : So if you want me to weigh in, that’s what {i}I’d{/i} recommend. Give {i}Sana{/i} his time to shine and have him and Akira spitroast that perky little slut, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 所以如果要我发表意见，{i}我{/i}推荐这个。让{i}Sana{/i}得到一次出彩的机会，让他和 Akira 一起把那个活泼的小骚货 Noriko 夹在中间烤。

lines.en: : You...You want me to...do it on camera?...But I...that’s...
lines.zh: : 你……你想让我……在镜头前做？……可是我……那……
: 还有 Karin 这个选项。

lines.en: : Karin? But I thought she didn’t renew her contract?
lines.zh: : Karin？可我以为她没续约？

lines.en: : Yeah, because she found a new job that pays way more. So I decided to do some digging into what that job {i}is{/i} and, guess what? She’s a fucking {i}dominatrix{/i} now.
lines.zh: : 对，因为她找了份薪水高得多的新工作。所以我决定去挖一挖那份工作{i}到底是什么{/i}，你猜怎么着？她现在是个他妈的{i}女王大人{/i}了。

lines.en: : There’s always {i}that{/i} option too, you know. If you’re {i}really{/i} desperate.
lines.zh: : 还有{i}那个{/i}选项哦。如果你{i}真的{/i}走投无路的话。
: {i}那个{/i}选项？
: Makoto……你不是指……
: Niki 和 Sekai，没错。
{i}观众已经发话了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And with nearly half of the vote, there was only one thing left to do...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而凭借将近半数的票数，只剩下一件事可做了……{/i}

lines.en: : The door’s open! You can let yourself in!
lines.zh: : 门开着呢！你自己进来就行！

lines.en: : Sorry I’m so late. I know the website said satisfaction guaranteed in thirty minutes or less.
lines.zh: : 抱歉来晚了。我知道网站上写着三十分钟内保证满意。

lines.en: : I just think it takes a little longer than that to get the job done sometimes...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，有时候要把活儿干完，得比那多花点时间……

lines.en: : A boy?! At our all-girls underwear-only slumber party?! How could something like this happen?!
lines.zh: : 一个男的？！在我们只穿内裤的全女睡衣派对上？！这种事怎么可能发生？！

lines.en: : Just shut up and take his money so we can go back to painting each other’s nails and having pillow fights.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，收下他的钱，我们好回去互相涂指甲油、打枕头仗。

lines.en: : Wait...That’s not just any boy...Isn’t that Noriko’s older brother?
lines.zh: : 等等……那可不是随便什么男的……那不是 Noriko 的哥哥吗？

lines.en: : Onii-chan?! I haven’t seen you in three years! If I’d only known you were a pizza delivery boy, I would have ordered one so much sooner!
lines.zh: : 哥哥？！我都三年没见到你了！要是我早知道你是送披萨的，我早就下单了！

lines.en: : That’s pizza delivery {i}man{/i} to you. And if you girls don’t have a way to pay, then-
lines.zh: : 对你们来说，那是送披萨的{i}男人{/i}。还有，如果你们几个付不出钱，那就——

lines.en: : Cut?! But I was doing such a good job! I remembered all my lines and everything!
lines.zh: : 卡？！可我演得那么好！我把台词全记住了，什么都记住了！

lines.en: : Yeah, here’s the thing, though. You kind of {i}didn’t.{/i} So we’ll start again from the top, but this time you need to walk in and say, “Did somebody order a pizza?”
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过问题是，你其实{i}没{/i}记住。所以我们从头再来一遍，但这次你要走进来说：「有人点披萨吗？」

lines.en: : Why? Doesn’t the pizza box give that away? Or my super cool pizza hat?
lines.zh: : 为什么？披萨盒不是已经说明了吗？还是我这顶超酷的披萨帽？

lines.en: : If this was ten years ago, sure. But this is going up on Netflix and they’re all about “second screen” viewing now.
lines.zh: : 要是十年前，那当然行。但这部要上 Netflix，而他们现在就吃「第二屏」观看这一套。

lines.en: : So we need to narrate basically everything that’s happening so people on their phones can understand the plot too. Can you do that for me?
lines.zh: : 所以我们基本上得把发生的一切都念出来，好让刷手机的人也能看懂剧情。你能帮我做到吗？
: 不用。
: 太好了！那就从头再来！

lines.en: : {i}Ughhhhhhhhhh! Just let me make up my own lines again! I’m so much better at improv than I am at reciting Nodoka’s fucking scripts! There are always so many spelling errors!
lines.zh: : {i}呃啊啊啊啊啊啊！就让我再自己编台词吧！我即兴发挥比背 Nodoka 那该死的剧本强太多了！里面总有那么多拼写错误！

lines.en: : It’s okay, Akira! You’ve got this!
lines.zh: : 没事的，Akira！你能行的！
: 第 1-A 场——第 2 条！
: 开拍！
: 有人点鸡巴吗？

lines.en: : Again?! What did I do this time?!
lines.zh: : 又来？！我这次又怎么了？！
: 你把「披萨」说成了「鸡巴」。

lines.en: : I thought that was another one of Nodoka’s spelling errors!
lines.zh: : 我还以为那又是 Nodoka 的一个拼写错误！

lines.en: : But I literally just told you that-
lines.zh: : 可我才刚跟你说过——

lines.en: : I’m giving you {i}one{/i} more take and that’s it. I have a foot massage in thirty minutes that I’m going to be {i}really{/i} grumpy about missing.
lines.zh: : 我再给你{i}一条{/i}，就一条。我三十分钟后有个足部按摩，要是错过我会{i}非常{/i}不高兴。

lines.en: : Dad, we’ve been filming for two minutes. And I had Ayane cancel your foot massage.
lines.zh: : 爸，我们才拍了两分钟。而且我让 Ayane 把你的足部按摩取消了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Akira! I’ll give you one myself later if you’re not too tired from all of the sex you’re about to have!
lines.zh: : 对不起，Akira！要是你等下做完那些爱之后没累趴下，我晚点亲自给你按！

lines.en: : You cancelled my foot massage?! That’s it! I hate you! And it makes me even {i}grumpier{/i} that you keep calling me your dad when I’m not even {i}playing{/i} that role anymore!
lines.zh: : 你取消了我的足部按摩？！够了！我恨你！而且你一直叫我爸，可我已经{i}不演{/i}那个角色了，这让我{i}更{/i}不高兴！

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. Your performance in Lessons in Love was just so convincing that I started to think you actually {i}were{/i} my dad. But I’ll try to stop if-
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。你在《Lessons in Love》里的表演太有说服力了，我都不由得以为你真的是{i}我{/i}爸了。但我会尽量改掉，如果——

lines.en: : No. I understand now. And I shouldn’t fault you for falling victim to my immeasurable skill and raw talent.
lines.zh: : 不。我现在明白了。也不该怪你败在我那不可估量的技巧与纯粹的天赋之下。

lines.en: : I suppose I’ll allow you to keep calling me “Dad” for now. But-
lines.zh: : 我想，暂时允许你继续叫我「爸」吧。不过——
: 太好了！那就从头再来！
: 至少让我把话说完！

lines.en: : You can do it, snookums! We all believe in you!
lines.zh: : 你能行的，小甜心！我们都相信你！

lines.en: : Ami, really quick. For the line in scene 4-A where I’m supposed to walk in on Akira and Noriko, all of my lines were scribbled out. So if there are any last minute changes-
lines.zh: : Ami，就一句。4-A 场里我该撞见 Akira 和 Noriko 的那段，我的台词全被划掉了。所以如果有什么最后一刻的改动——

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I guess no one told you. We cut that scene and are going with something else instead. You’ll still be paid in full, though.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。看来没人告诉你。那场戏我们剪掉了，换成别的内容。不过你的钱还是照付全额。

lines.en: : Wait, my scene was {i}cut?{/i} Is...Is it the nudity thing? Because I told Miss Tsukioka I’m {i}fine{/i} with it. And if it’s a financial issue-
lines.zh: : 等等，我的戏被{i}剪了？{/i}是……是因为裸露那件事吗？因为我跟 Tsukioka 小姐说过我{i}没问题{/i}。如果是钱的问题——

lines.en: : Not now, Yasu. Kirin! Slate, please!
lines.zh: : 现在别说这个，Yasu。Kirin！打板！
: 第 1-A 场——第 3 条！
: 开拍！
: 有人点披……{i}披萨吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, right here! And we are {i}starving.{/i} But...weren’t you supposed to be here fifteen minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 哦，这边！我们{i}饿死了{/i}。不过……你不是十五分钟前就该到了吗？

lines.en: : Sorry I’m so late. I know the website said satisfaction guaranteed in thirty minutes or less.
lines.zh: : 抱歉来晚了。我知道网站上写着三十分钟内保证满意。

lines.en: : I just think it takes a little longer than that to get the job done sometimes...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，有时候要把活儿干完，得比那多花点时间……

lines.en: : A boy?! At our all-girls underwear-only slumber party?! How could something like this happen?!
lines.zh: : 一个男的？！在我们只穿内裤的全女睡衣派对上？！这种事怎么可能发生？！

lines.en: : Just shut up and take his money so we can go back to painting each other’s nails and having pillow fights.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，收下他的钱，我们好回去互相涂指甲油、打枕头仗。

lines.en: : That’s not just any boy...Isn’t that Noriko’s older brother?
lines.zh: : 那可不是随便什么男的……那不是 Noriko 的哥哥吗？

lines.en: : Onii-chan?! I haven’t seen you in three years! If I’d only known you were a pizza delivery boy, I would have ordered one so much sooner!
lines.zh: : 哥哥？！我都三年没见到你了！要是我早知道你是送披萨的，我早就下单了！

lines.en: : That’s pizza delivery {i}man{/i} to you. And if you girls don’t have a way to pay, then I might have to just take my penis and leave...
lines.zh: : 对你们来说，那是送披萨的{i}男人{/i}。而且如果你们几个付不出钱，那我可能只好带着我的鸡巴走了……

lines.en: : Just keep rolling. We’ll fix it later.
lines.zh: : 继续拍。我们之后再修。

lines.en: : W...We have money! I just- ah! Oh no...
lines.zh: : 我……我们有钱！我只是——啊！糟了……

lines.en: : I...I think I left my wallet at home...
lines.zh: : 我……我想我把钱包落在家里了……

lines.en: : Surely one of you girls brought some money with you...right?
lines.zh: : 你们几个里总有人带了钱吧……对吧？

lines.en: : D...Don’t look at me...I’m not g...good around boys...
lines.zh: : 别……别看我……我在男的面前……不太行……

lines.en: : And I am a lesbian who’s only here for all of the tickle fights we are going to have.
lines.zh: : 而我是个女同性恋，我来这儿只是为了我们等下要玩的那些挠痒痒大战。

lines.en: : Onii-chan...can’t you make an exception for your little sister? We’re {i}reaaaaally{/i} hungry. And if we don’t eat soon, something {i}really{/i} bad might happen.
lines.zh: : 哥哥……你就不能为你的妹妹破一次例吗？我们{i}真的真的{/i}很饿。要是我们不快点吃东西，可能会发生{i}非常{/i}糟糕的事。

lines.en: : No can do, Noriko. Sister or not, a man needs to get paid. And if you don’t have the cash, I really {i}am{/i} going to take my penis and leave.
lines.zh: : 不行，Noriko。不管是不是妹妹，男人总得拿到钱。如果你们没现金，我是{i}真的{/i}要带着我的鸡巴走了。
: 哦，他妈的真见鬼。

lines.en: : You need to stop saying “penis” instead of “pizza,” Akira. You’re going to spoil the plot for all of the viewers.
lines.zh: : Akira，你别再把「披萨」说成「鸡巴」了。你会给所有观众剧透的。

lines.en: : She’s right, baby! And the sooner we finish shooting, the sooner we can cuddle up in bed with a nice warm mug of regular milk.
lines.zh: : 她说得对，宝贝！而且我们越早拍完，就越早能窝在床上，配着一杯热腾腾的普通牛奶。

lines.en: : Maybe we could rehearse this scene a little more? We did kind of jump into shooting before summer vacation was even over. Maybe Onii-chan just needs more time to remember all of the lines?
lines.zh: : 也许我们可以把这场戏再排练一下？毕竟暑假还没结束我们就直接开拍了。也许哥哥只是需要多点时间来记住所有台词？
: Chika！东西呢——
: 知道了，知道了。我这就去。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}I’m never going to win an Oscar at this rate.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}照这个速度，我这辈子都拿不到奥斯卡了。

lines.en: : Akira, with all due respect, you’ve been doing this for ten years now. And I don’t mean to be rude but, if you’re still having trouble remembering such simple lines, then...
lines.zh: : Akira，恕我直言，你干这行已经十年了。我不想说得难听，但如果你连这么简单的台词都还记不住，那……

lines.en: : Then what?! Just say it, Yasu! I can handle it!
lines.zh: : 那什么？！你就直说，Yasu！我扛得住！

lines.en: : Then maybe there’s a...different position you can handle! One better suited to your...{i}talents.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那也许有个……别的岗位你扛得住！一个更适合你……{i}天赋{/i}的岗位。

lines.en: : It’s hard enough winning an Oscar for pornography, my wolf. You shouldn’t let it get you down just because you aren’t Yasu.
lines.zh: : 拍色情片能拿到奥斯卡已经够难了，我的狼。你不该因为自己不是 Yasu 就这么沮丧。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah! And besides, mine was kind of a fluke anyway. I was doing so much cocaine the year I won that I barely remember anything that happened.
lines.zh: : 对……对！再说，我那个本来也算是撞大运。我拿奖那年吸可卡因吸太多了，那阵子发生的事我基本都不记得了。

lines.en: : Onii-chan, maybe you just need to relax? Want to go practice our sex scene together for a few hours to help you get all of the nerves out?
lines.zh: : 哥哥，也许你只是需要放松一下？要不要一起去把我们的性爱戏练上几个小时，帮你把紧张都排出去？

lines.en: : No...you’re always too wet and it makes my penis feel like it’s lost in the ocean. I want to have sex with Chika instead.
lines.zh: : 不要……你总是太湿了，让我感觉我的鸡巴像迷失在大海里。我想改跟 Chika 做。
: 想都别想。

lines.en: : Well what about that girl who played your little sister? I need to feel strong and want somebody who’s going to fight back.
lines.zh: : 那演你妹妹的那个女孩呢？我需要感觉自己很强，我想要个会反抗的。

lines.en: : Hey, Ami? How much trouble would I be in if I just ripped this thing off?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Ami？要是我直接把这玩意儿扯下来，会惹多大麻烦？

lines.en: : Please don’t rip it off, Chika. You’re the only one who can consistently turn him on since he’s so afraid of you.
lines.zh: : 拜托别扯，Chika。你是唯一能稳定让他勃起的人，因为他这么怕你。

lines.en: : Getting hard from being scared is a surprisingly common biological reaction!
lines.zh: : 被吓硬其实是一种出奇常见的生理反应！

lines.en: : Come on! Let me just help Chika a little bit and-
lines.zh: : 拜托嘛！就让我帮 Chika 一点点，然后——

lines.en: : L-Let’s all help! If my hubby needs a little support, the least we can do is all chip in to make sure he gets it!
lines.zh: : 我……我们大家一起帮！如果我老公需要一点支持，我们至少能做的就是一起出力，保证他能得到！

lines.en: : Everyone who’s not directly involved in production, come over here and get on your knees so we can break the record for the world’s largest off-screen cooperative fellatio!
lines.zh: : 所有不直接参与制作的人都过来跪下，我们来打破「世界最大规模幕后合作口交」的纪录！

lines.en: : Oh, wow. That Nao-chan girl’s improved. She can fit the whole thing in her mouth now.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。那个 Nao-chan 进步了。她现在能把整根都塞进嘴里了。

lines.en: : I’ve got a bad feeling about this, Ayane. Niki hasn’t been answering my calls all morning. And if we have to shoot regular porn, it’s not going to go over well at the box office.
lines.zh: : 我有个不好的预感，Ayane。Niki 整个上午都没接我电话。如果我们只能拍普通色情片，票房不会好看的。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it make more sense to just have Noriko call her since they’re related?
lines.zh: : 既然她们是亲戚，让 Noriko 打给她不是更合理吗？

lines.en: : No, because Noriko would tell Akira. And if {i}Akira{/i} knew Niki was even {i}asked{/i} to be involved, he’d call off the shoot altogether and we’d have to hire some {i}other{/i} guy.
lines.zh: : 不行，因为 Noriko 会告诉 Akira。而如果{i}Akira{/i}知道有人甚至{i}只是问过{/i}Niki 要不要参与，他就会把整个拍摄取消，我们还得去雇{i}别的{/i}男人。

lines.en: : I think that’s a great idea. Pretty much everyone but us is tired of having sex with him after only doing that for ten years. Most of them have been asking for a change since like Chapter 3.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这主意挺好的。除了我们俩，基本上所有人跟他做了十年都腻了。大多数人从第三章左右就一直在要求换人。

lines.en: : Noriko and Yumi aren’t bored of it either, but I get what you’re saying.
lines.zh: : Noriko 和 Yumi 也没腻，不过我懂你的意思。

lines.en: : It’d be easier taking him for ourselves when you think about it that way too.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，把他据为己有也更容易了。

lines.en: : Is that why your nipples are so hard right now? You’re thinking about kidnapping him again?
lines.zh: : 所以你乳头现在才这么硬？你又在想绑架他的事了？

lines.en: : No, it’s just really cold in here. Can we turn the AC down?
lines.zh: : 不是，这里只是真的很冷。能把空调调低点吗？

lines.en: : Not until there’s no longer an orgy in the way.
lines.zh: : 等前面不再挡着一场群交再说。

lines.en: : Hey. How come you guys aren’t joining in on the orgy?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你们俩怎么不加入那场群交？

lines.en: : When did you even get here?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候来的？

lines.en: : Io posted a picture of it on her OnlyFans and I ran here as fast as I could.
lines.zh: : Io 把照片发到她 OnlyFans 上了，我就拼命跑过来了。
: 你订阅了 Io 的 OnlyFans？

lines.en: : Think of me however you want for that, but it’s come in handy more times than I can count.
lines.zh: : 随你怎么想我，但这东西帮上忙的次数多到数不清。

lines.en: : Also, I may have killed Tyler. But it was an accident, I swear.
lines.zh: : 另外，我可能把 Tyler 杀了。但那是个意外，我发誓。
: 总之，我的戏是什么时候？

lines.en: : You don’t have a scene in this production, Maya. You got more than enough screen time in the last movie and get to take this one off. Now, go make sure Tyler’s properly buried or something.
lines.zh: : 这部作品里没有你的戏，Maya。上一部电影你的镜头已经多得过分了，这一部你可以歇着。现在，去确保 Tyler 被好好埋了或者什么的。

lines.en: : So you’re, like...{i}actually{/i} serious about letting Noriko star? And not casting me isn’t just some joke that I haven’t gotten the punchline to yet?
lines.zh: : 所以你是……{i}真的{/i}要让 Noriko 当主角？不选我这事不是个我还没听懂笑点的玩笑？

lines.en: : She won fair and square, as crazy as that sounds. But who knows if we’ll even get to shooting a full scene at this rate?
lines.zh: : 她赢得光明正大，虽然听起来很疯。但照这个速度，谁知道我们还能不能拍完一整场戏？

lines.en: : Why are your nipples so hard? Is it the AC?
lines.zh: : 你乳头怎么这么硬？是空调的关系？

lines.en: : I asked Ami to turn it down and she said no. I wonder if this is how the cast of Friends felt for all 236 episodes?
lines.zh: : 我让 Ami 调低，她说不行。不知道《老友记》的演员在整整 236 集里是不是都是这种感觉？

lines.en: : Can one of you just go get me a coffee or something? Nodoka isn’t here today and I have to figure out how to fix the script since Niki and my mom clearly aren’t going to-
lines.zh: : 你们谁去给我买杯咖啡什么的？Nodoka 今天不在，而我得想办法把剧本改好，因为 Niki 和我妈显然不打算——

lines.en: : Wait! Everybody, pause the orgy! Niki and Sekai are here!
lines.zh: : 等等！各位，群交先暂停！Niki 和 Sekai 来了！

lines.en: : Well, it looks like things haven’t changed in Kumon-mi even one bit.
lines.zh: : 看来 Kumon-mi 一点都没变。
: 妈？！你来了？！

lines.en: : Oh, Noriko. I see you’re right where I left you. On the ground like some whore.
lines.zh: : 哦，Noriko。我看你还待在我离开时的位置。趴在地上，像个婊子。

lines.en: : Me?! You’ve been in over a hundred adult films since you left Japan! You were America’s highest grossing porn star last year! If anyone’s the whore here, it’s you!
lines.zh: : 我？！你离开日本之后拍了上百部成人片！你去年是美国票房最高的色情明星！这儿要是有谁是婊子，那就是你！
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: 哦。{i}你{/i}也在啊。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking the Tsukioka Foundation wouldn’t {i}ever{/i} be dumb enough to hire {i}you{/i} as the lead for two straight productions, {i}Onii-chan.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我还以为 Tsukioka 财团{i}绝不会{/i}蠢到连续两部作品都雇{i}你{/i}当主角呢，{i}哥哥。{/i}
: Ni……Ni……Ni……Niki？！我……呃……啊啊……哈啊啊啊！什……我不……

lines.en: : You’ll be okay, babe! There’s no need to be nervous. Just do it like we practiced, okay?
lines.zh: : 你会没事的，宝贝！不用紧张。就照我们练的那样做，好吗？
: Aaaah...aaaaaahahahh?!?!?!!

lines.en: : So, like...why {i}are{/i} you here? I figured you’d be chilling in the mansion all your dirty sex-money bought you or something.
lines.zh: : 那个……你{i}到底{/i}为什么在这儿？我还以为你会待在你那些肮脏的性爱钱买来的豪宅里享清闲之类的。

lines.en: : Because you guys are in some deep shit, obviously. You really think something as {i}uninspired{/i} as this fucking...{i}pizza{/i} nonsense is going to earn you any money? Of course not.
lines.zh: : 因为你们惹上大麻烦了，很明显。你真觉得这种{i}毫无创意{/i}的、操蛋的……{i}披萨{/i}闹剧能给你们赚到钱？当然不能。

lines.en: : Like, just {i}look{/i} at this pathetic piece of shit and his stupid little hat. I’ve been more turned on by Domino’s drivers.
lines.zh: : 就说，你{i}看看{/i}这个可悲的废物和他那顶蠢帽子。达美乐的外送员都比他让我有性致。

lines.en: : Y...You aren’t...supposed to...come near me anymore! I...I got a restraining order!
lines.zh: : 你……你不该……再靠近我了！我……我申请了限制令！

lines.en: : What, you think I {i}want{/i} to come near you? I’m only doing this because of familial obligations. If the two of you fail with your stupid incest porn, it reflects poorly on me.
lines.zh: : 什么，你以为我{i}想{/i}靠近你？我只是出于家族义务才做这个。要是你们俩的蠢乱伦片搞砸了，我的脸上也不好看。

lines.en: : So are you here to, like...{i}coach{/i} us or something? Because I’ve had plenty of sex, obviously. But never as the star. And you’re like, {i}way{/i} experienced at this point, so-
lines.zh: : 所以你是来，那个……{i}指导{/i}我们的吗？因为性爱我当然做过很多。但从没当过主角。而你现在{i}超级{/i}有经验了，所以 ——

lines.en: : Noriko, I’m not here to coach you.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我不是来指导你的。

lines.en: : Well I’ll be fucking damned if I let you take my role so just back off if that’s the case.
lines.zh: : 我要是让你抢了我的角色，就让我不得好死。所以要真是那样，你就退一边去。

lines.en: : That’s not the case either. Sekai and I are joining you guys. We’re having a foursome.
lines.zh: : 也不是那么回事。Sekai 和我要加入你们。我们要来一场四人行。
: {i}四人行？{/i}

lines.en: : Th...There better not be any other girls involved! You know I can’t handle more than three or I get nervous!
lines.zh: : 最……最好不要还有其他女孩！你知道的，超过三个我就应付不来、会紧张！

lines.en: : So, like...me with Sensei and you with Sekai? Why didn’t anybody tell me about this until now?
lines.zh: : 所以，那个……我跟 Sensei，你跟 Sekai？为什么到现在才有人告诉我？

lines.en: : Obviously because of Onii-chan and his stupid restraining order which I have to violate for the sake of art.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为哥哥和他那张愚蠢的禁制令 —— 而我为了艺术必须违反它。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess having this much incest would spice up the film. But the general population still doesn’t know that Akira is our brother. So if it’s just a matter of using your star power-
lines.zh: : 我是说……乱伦到这个程度确实能给片子加点料。可大众还不知道 Akira 是我们哥哥。所以如果只是借用你的明星效应——

lines.en: : Noriko, I’m going to fuck {i}you{/i} on camera. That’s how we spice this up.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我要在镜头前操{i}你{/i}。这才是加料的方式。
: 可……那是我的活儿！

lines.en: : Wait, so I’m paired with {i}you{/i} and {i}Onii-chan{/i} is with your girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 等等，所以我跟{i}你{/i}配，{i}哥哥{/i}跟你女朋友？

lines.en: : No. We’re all paired with you. And we are going to use and abuse you for the sake of adult entertainment until you are pushed beyond your breaking point.
lines.zh: : 不。我们全都跟你配。而且我们会为了成人娱乐把你用尽、虐尽，直到你被推过崩溃的临界点。

lines.en: : It’s how I rose to stardom and now it’s {i}your{/i} turn to follow in my footsteps.
lines.zh: : 我就是这样爬上明星位置的，现在轮到{i}你{/i}踏着我的脚步走了。

lines.en: : {size=-2}So you better throw any sensibilities you still have out of the window because, a few hours from now, your head is going to be squeezed so tightly between my thighs that you might leave this place with brain damage.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}所以你最好把剩下的那点廉耻心都扔出窗外，因为再过几小时，你的脑袋会被我的大腿夹得那么紧，等你离开这儿的时候可能已经脑损伤了。{/size}
: 不客气。

lines.en: : What does any of this have to do with pizza?!
lines.zh: : 这到底跟披萨有什么关系？！
: Uh...h....aaahh...mnh...aa....
: 你……你……嗯……你看起来……好……好看……

lines.en: : I...didn’t realize you were actually coming.
lines.zh: : 我……没想到你真的会来。
: 我……我……想让你……成……成功……所以……如果……我……我能……帮……帮忙……

lines.en: : Well...thanks. But you don’t need to feel obligated to come talk to me if it makes you nervous. I’m doing fine on my own.
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢。不过如果跟我说话会让你紧张，你不必觉得非来不可。我一个人也没问题。

lines.en: : Of course. I’m the director now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 当然。现在我是导演了，不是吗？

lines.en: : And yeah, I’m sure that’s not all that impressive when you and Niki are working with more experienced directors every day. But I’ve gotta start somewhere, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你跟 Niki 每天都跟更有经验的导演合作，我这个肯定不算什么了不起的。但我总得有个开始吧，不是吗？
: 我……嗯……呃……是……的，我……想……你确实是……

lines.en: : Right. So just take a seat and relax and we’ll call you when it’s time to start shooting.
lines.zh: : 对。那你先坐下放松，等要开拍的时候我们叫你。

lines.en: : I gave Niki free {b}REIGN{/b} to choreograph the whole scene, so you guys can improv all you like. Just try to focus on Noriko as much as you can since I think we’re going to try and break her.
lines.zh: : 整场戏的动作编排我都让 Niki 全权{b}发挥{/b}了，所以你们想怎么即兴都行。只要尽量把注意力放在 Noriko 身上就好 —— 因为我们打算把她逼崩。
: 好……好的……我……会……尽力的！不……不过……嗯……A……Ami？……
: 嗯，妈妈？怎么了？
: 我……我……还……把……你……你妹妹们……也……带来了……
: 你{i}做了什么?{/i}
: 他……他们一……一直在问……你的事，而我……我……没……没……选……选择！
: 对……对不起！我……我……对不起！
: 那她们在哪儿？
: 他……他们……啊……啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : We’re right where you left us!
lines.zh: : 就在你丢下我们的地方！

lines.en: : In the back of your mind! In a place we can’t escape from! The kind that exists no matter where or when or why you end up the places that you do!
lines.zh: : aa "在你脑海的深处！在一个我们逃不掉的地方！那种无论你在何时、何地、因为什么走到那些地方，它都存在的东西！"
: Cha cha cha。

lines.en: : I...I can’t...keep them...away! Th...They just...keep...g...getting out!
lines.zh: : 我……我拦不住……她们！她……她们就是……一直……跑……跑出来！

lines.en: : Beautiful girl! Yellow as the sun as the sun as the sun on the day you were born! O, the places you have been! The sights the sights the sights you’ve seen!
lines.zh: : 漂亮的女孩！黄得像太阳，像太阳，像你出生那天的太阳！噢，你去过的地方！你看过的，看过的，看过的风景！

lines.en: : Escaped, but not from here! Erased, but not from there! So tell me tell me tell me TELL ME TELL ME TELL ME where?
lines.zh: : aa "逃出来了，但不是从这里！被抹掉了，但不是从那里！所以告诉我告诉我告诉我 —— 告诉我告诉我告诉我，在哪里？"

lines.en: : So it just floods the whole box then?
lines.zh: : 所以整个盒子都被淹了？
: 然后我就永远溺水？
: 这……这就是……我……我……不得不……离……离开的原因！
: 你……你为什么……要……选……那个选项？！
: 我没撑住。
: 我从来都听不见。

lines.en: : I just follow the script I’m given.
lines.zh: : 我只是照着拿到的剧本来演。
: 但我好……
: 在所有这些悲伤的结局里。

lines.en: : Then all we can do is make the choice a little harder this time!
lines.zh: : 那我们能做的，就是这次把选择变得更难一点！

lines.en: : There are two pills you can take. One to sink and one to swim. But I won’t tell you which is which!
lines.zh: : aa "你可以吃两颗药。一颗让你下沉，一颗让你游起来。但我不会告诉你哪颗是哪颗！"

lines.en: : One leads to a sad ending. The other, a {i}bad{/i} ending! So you can’t say we never tried to HOLD YOUR HEAD ABOVE THE WATER.
lines.zh: : 一个通向悲伤的结局。另一个通向{i}糟糕{/i}的结局！所以你不能说我们从没试着把你的头托出水面。

lines.en: : So when you inevitably find yourself falling again, you can think longer and harder about the {i}right{/i} choice this time!
lines.zh: : aa "所以当你不可避免地又一次下坠时，你可以更久、更用力地想一想这次{i}正确{/i}的选择！"

lines.en: : Where could it be? {i}What{/i} could it be? And COULD a solution be found in such an unlikely realm AT ALL?
lines.zh: : 它会在哪儿？{i}它{/i}会是什么？而在这么不可能的地方，究竟能不能找到解决办法？
: 选择权在他们手上！

lines.en: : It is only the OUTCOME that belongs to you!
lines.zh: : 属于你的只有结局！
